description: Weighted priority index. Each component is normalised to 0..1 across the groups being scored, then weighted, then scaled to 0..100. The breakdown travels with the score.

component_definitions.severity: Mean low/medium/high/critical weight of the group's complaints (unknown counts as 0).
component_definitions.affected_population: log1p of the summed affected population, divided by the largest group.
component_definitions.volume: log1p of the complaint count, divided by the largest group.
component_definitions.district_spread: Distinct districts in the group divided by 24.
component_definitions.recurrence: Share of the group's reports whose normalised text was already reported in that group.
